The **ESC guidelines** (European Society of Cardiology guidelines) serve as the primary international professional reference for the clinical management of atrial fibrillation (AF). In the context of the Danish healthcare system, these guidelines are highly significant because they establish the evidence-based foundation for structured [[patientuddannelse|Patientuddannelse]] (patient education) for newly diagnosed AF patients, directly shaping national clinical practices and quality indicators.

The evolution of the ESC guidelines reflects a growing emphasis on patient-centered care. In 2021, the guidelines authored by Hindricks et al. explicitly recommended patient education for individuals with AF, laying the groundwork for the integrated ABC Pathway [^src2]. Building on this international evidence, a specific Danish guideline detailing the content of patient education was developed in 2023 [^src1]. The most recent updates in 2024 (Van Gelder et al.) further elevated the status of patient education, recommending it for both AF patients and their relatives as a "central and integrated part of basic treatment" [^src4]. 

Within the Danish quality assurance framework, the ESC guidelines have a direct structural impact. They inform the development of and provide the evidentiary basis for [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed AF patients receiving structured education within their first year [^src1]. Furthermore, the guidelines support [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]] [^src3] and incorporate comprehensive care frameworks such as the [[care-modellen|CARE modellen]], where patient education is highlighted as a core element [^src4]. By bridging international cardiology standards with local quality metrics, the ESC guidelines ensure that patient education is not merely an optional add-on, but a mandated, measurable component of fundamental AF treatment in Denmark.

## Timeline
- **2021**: ESC guidelines fra Hindricks et al. anbefaler patientuddannelse til patienter med atrieflimren og danner grundlag for ABC Pathway [^src2]
- **2023**: Der er udarbejdet en retningslinje for indholdet i patientundervisning med udgangspunkt i ESC guidelines. [^src1]
- **2024**: Udgivelse af ESC-guidelines for atrieflimren, som anbefaler patientuddannelse som central og integreret del af behandling. [^src4]
